## 更新内容

### 歌词开头的署名改为默认显示

- 任务栏歌词和桌面歌词不再默认跳过开头的歌名、歌手、作词、作曲、编曲、制作人等署名行，这些行会按时间轴正常显示。
- 原来的跳过行为移到设置页「实验」分区，开关名为“跳过歌词开头的署名”，默认关闭。开启后与 v1.6.2 及之前的行为相同。
- 开头的空行、“纯音乐”之类的标记和只有符号的行仍然跳过，前奏阶段的显示不变。
- 主窗口歌词面板一直显示全部歌词行，不受此项影响。

## 安装与升级

下载 `Lyrider_1.6.3.0_x64.msix` 和 `Lyrider.cer`，仅支持 Windows 11 x64。首次安装前，将证书导入当前用户的“受信任人”存储，再安装 MSIX：

```powershell
Import-Certificate -FilePath .\Lyrider.cer -CertStoreLocation Cert:\CurrentUser\TrustedPeople
Add-AppxPackage .\Lyrider_1.6.3.0_x64.msix
```

已有版本使用同一证书签名时，可直接安装新 MSIX 升级。安装包包含 .NET、Windows App SDK 运行时和中英文资源。Cider 插件 `Lyrider-Cider-Plugin_1.0.0.zip` 与 v1.6.1 相同，已安装的无需更新。

## 验证

- Release 构建 0 警告 0 错误；逻辑及服务测试（Release）：378/378 通过，新增关闭署名过滤时任务栏与桌面歌词的测试。
- 任务栏控件测试（Release）：58/58 通过。

完整变更：[v1.6.2...v1.6.3](https://github.com/Ayor1337/Lyrider/compare/v1.6.2...v1.6.3)

## Changes in English

### Leading lyric credits are now shown by default

- The taskbar and desktop lyrics no longer skip the title, artist, lyricist, composer, arranger, producer and similar credit lines at the start of the lyrics by default. These lines now show on the timeline like any other line.
- The old behavior moved to a new "Skip leading lyric credits" switch in the Experimental section of Settings, off by default. Turning it on restores the behavior of v1.6.2 and earlier.
- Leading blank lines, markers such as "Instrumental" and symbol-only lines are still skipped, so nothing changes during the intro.
- The main window lyrics panel always shows every line and is not affected.

### Installation and verification

Download `Lyrider_1.6.3.0_x64.msix` and `Lyrider.cer` for Windows 11 x64. For a first installation, import the certificate into the current user's Trusted People store using the commands above, then install the MSIX. Existing installations signed with the same certificate can upgrade directly. The Cider plugin `Lyrider-Cider-Plugin_1.0.0.zip` is unchanged from v1.6.1.

The Release build had no warnings or errors. All 378 logic/service tests, including new tests for the taskbar and desktop lyrics with credit skipping off, and all 58 taskbar widget tests passed.

Full changelog: [v1.6.2...v1.6.3](https://github.com/Ayor1337/Lyrider/compare/v1.6.2...v1.6.3)
